none: PAS KENT-764A02: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Bust right. Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two Victories facing one another, each holding a wreath. Inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGG QNN]. Reece period 17. Die axis: 6 o'clock. This coin is in fine condition with some wear. All the edges of the coin have broken down leaving an oval shaped coin. Dark green patina with some rusty brown staining especially on the obverse. This coin is likely to date to 347-348AD. Ref.
